confidentialite.heading: Privacy Policy
confidentialite.v1Notice: For V1. To be updated once the company is legally incorporated.
confidentialite.intro: This policy describes how Agoris collects, uses and protects your personal data, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection legislation.

responsable.title: Data Controller
responsable.body: Agoris SAS (to be completed), based in Paris. Contact:

donnees.title: Data Collected
donnees.item1: Email address: when you create an account, subscribe to a trade show alert, or sign up for our newsletter.
donnees.item2: Editorial preferences: sectors and cities followed, to personalise your alerts.
donnees.item3: Anonymised technical data: browser type, pages visited (via Google Analytics 4).

finalites.title: Purposes of Processing
finalites.item1: To send you the trade show alerts you have subscribed to.
finalites.item2: To send you our monthly newsletter (only with explicit consent).
finalites.item3: To improve the service by measuring audience in an aggregated manner.

baseLegale.title: Legal Basis
baseLegale.body: Your data is processed on the basis of your consent (explicit sign-up) or Agoris's legitimate interest in providing a relevant editorial service.

conservation.title: Retention Period
conservation.body: Account and subscription data is retained for as long as your account is active, and for up to 3 years after your last interaction. Anonymised analytics data is retained for 14 months (Google Analytics settings).

droits.title: Your Rights
droits.intro: You have the following rights at any time:
droits.item1: Right of access to your personal data.
droits.item3: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten).
droits.item6: Right to withdraw your consent at any time.
droits.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact our DPO at
droits.cnil: In case of dispute, you may contact the relevant supervisory authority in your country.

partage.title: Data Sharing
partage.body: Agoris does not sell or rent your data. It may be shared only with our technical sub-processors (Vercel hosting, Supabase database, Google Analytics audience measurement), all of whom are bound by confidentiality and security commitments compliant with the GDPR.

meta.title: Cookie Policy
meta.description: Agoris cookie policy: essential cookies and anonymised audience measurement.

cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.v1Notice: For V1. To be updated once the company is legally incorporated.
cookies.intro: Agoris uses cookies to ensure the site functions correctly and to measure its audience in an anonymised manner. No marketing or advertising cookies are placed at this stage.

essentiels.title: Essential Cookies
essentiels.body: These cookies are essential for the site to function and cannot be disabled. They do not require consent.
essentiels.supabase: manages your session (login, authentication). Duration: session duration or 7 days if you select "Remember me".

audience.title: Audience Measurement Cookies
audience.body: Agoris uses Google Analytics 4 to measure the site's audience in an anonymised manner (IP anonymisation enabled, no advertising sharing). This data helps us improve the service.
audience.ga: Google Analytics identifiers. Duration: 13 months maximum.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.body: No marketing or advertising cookies are placed on Agoris at the POC stage.

gestion.title: Cookie Management
gestion.p1: You can refuse analytics cookies directly in your browser settings (private mode, tracker blocking, extensions such as uBlock Origin). Refusing these cookies does not prevent use of the site.
